verdict.rationale: OpenCode has a desktop app with tabs (macOS/Windows/Linux) and explicitly supports starting multiple agents in parallel on the same project, satisfying the 'multiple sessions side by side' part of the story, but no evidence pack item mentions a visual diff-review UI or diff viewer in the desktop app. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or screenshots of a visual diff-review feature, independent hands-on confirmation that desktop tabs actually run separate sessions side by side.
